keyPoints.en: Ergonomics = fitting products to people; anthropometrics = body measurements.
keyPoints.bm: Ergonomik = menyesuaikan produk dengan manusia; antropometrik = ukuran tubuh.

keyPoints.en: Clearance (doors, knee space): use tall users' sizes. Reach (shelves, switches): use short users' sizes.
keyPoints.bm: Ruang (pintu, ruang lutut): gunakan saiz pengguna tinggi. Jangkauan (rak, suis): gunakan saiz pengguna rendah.

keyPoints.en: Balance function, ergonomics, aesthetics (colour, shape, texture), safety and cost.
keyPoints.bm: Imbangkan fungsi, ergonomik, estetik (warna, bentuk, tekstur), keselamatan dan kos.

keyPoints.en: Reduce > reuse > recycle > dispose. Choose renewable or recycled materials.
keyPoints.bm: Kurangkan > guna semula > kitar semula > buang. Pilih bahan boleh diperbaharui atau kitar semula.

keyPoints.en: Design products to last, be repaired and be taken apart for recycling.
keyPoints.bm: Reka produk yang tahan lama, boleh dibaiki dan boleh dileraikan untuk dikitar semula.
